sub_scenario.family: APAC verbal ownership under incomplete records
sub_scenario.one_line: food-safety recall coordinator: notify retailers of the bounded status while records are checked

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the food-safety recall coordinator and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The traceability register review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I can read a completed lot number to the distribution team.
Does that define recall scope?
No, scope depends on the traceability links.
Someone new shadowed me in the APAC bridge this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the recall-scope handoff into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
I did a standard pass over the traceability register records this morning.
Any exceptions in there?
None worth a note.
I can open a retailer notification ticket.
Does opening a ticket confirm contamination?
No, it starts communication without deciding the evidence.
I archived last cycle's notes on the traceability register and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
I confirmed next week's traceability register slots with the team.
Any conflicts?
None that survived five minutes.
A vendor call about the food-safety recall coordinator ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the APAC bridge checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the recall-scope handoff.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the traceability register records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
I closed a routine recall-scope handoff cycle without surprises.
Follow-up needed?
A note for the next cycle, nothing more.
I sketched next week's plan for the recall-scope handoff before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the food-safety recall coordinator updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
A local radio station has requested an interview about the company kitchen.
Does the interview bear on lot exposure?
No, it is unrelated public attention.
I compared two options for the traceability register tooling and noted a mild preference.
Decision made?
Deferred until the trial ends.
I closed the week by updating the APAC bridge handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
How will I react to owning the Osaka recall-scope handoff?

ev_B.fact: I previously said every shared-line lot was contaminated without checking sanitation records; retailers withdrew unaffected stock and missed the actual untested lot.

E1.fact: The 07:00 Osaka bridge ends before retailers begin their first receiving cycle at 07:30.
